Anna learned a lot about history. The story-writing desk is one of the best places in the city. Anna is going to travel to Toronto in October. An elderly gent held the door open for us.
Both of them like dumplings and juice. Anna hopes to visit Toronto one day. It takes twenty minutes to get to the story-writing desk by bike. What's more, his stamp collection fills three books.
Anna is reading a book about history. Anna usually has dumplings for breakfast. Anna wrote about the day in the diary.
